# Superseded

The extraction has moved to plain R scripts so it can run headless. Run both from
the repository root:

- [`R/extract_fitzroy.R`](extract_fitzroy.R) — AFL API player stats and match
  results (2012–2026) plus AFL Tables player stats with Brownlow votes
  (2012–2025).
- [`R/extract_squads.R`](extract_squads.R) — AFL API squad details per
  player-season (height, position) used for the height features.

```bash
Rscript R/extract_fitzroy.R
Rscript R/extract_squads.R
```

See [`data/README.md`](../data/README.md) for the output files and notes on
source coverage.
